comment: Ambiguous grading. She only remembered a handful of names by the end of the semester. I think she's retiring so there's no reason to write negative comments. I hope she enjoys her retirement
Just try to give her an impression that you are very active in the class. Then everything should be fine.
make sure to participate, but the workload is light and paper prompts are easy to follow

Attendance doesn't matter, there's only three papers, and you can breeze by, so I have no complaints. She goes off in tangents often, which was, honestly, funny. The essays are very flexible since you write about yourself. She's a sweet woman if you actually get to know her.

Over a two week period, she cancelled class 3 out of 4 times for no reason. She doesn't answer emails, doesn't use blackboard at all, takes MONTHS to grade. Does not seem to put enough effort into teaching the course as you would expect for this school.

i took this class as an eng gen ed and she grades papers so harshly and the midterm was so specific she like put quotes from certain pages & asked you to remember what that meant. she doesn't bother remembering her students' names and she has clear favoritism to certain people. dont take this class youll regret it omg please.

Took Noble Beasts during COVID. Class was on zoom. Mind-numbingly boring. She's a very sweet, kind-hearted woman, but even for an animal-lover like me, it could be too much. No quizzes, but not sure if that will stay the same once the pandemic ends. Hard to get feedback on essays. Some of the books were interesting (James Herriot's).

Dr. MacAllister is a nice lady, not a good teacher. Her class is unbelievably boring unless you like learning about animals. Seems clueless on how to use technology and hardly responds to emails. This class is reading-heavy. The only grades we received were from two essays and the final exam. Essay prompts were vague and difficult to get an A.

Today is the last day of classes and we still haven't gotten a single grade in this class. Had to go pass fail because she didn't tell us what we have. She doesn't make any effort to learn her students names and doesn't try to make class enjoyable at all. Such a waste of time, do yourself a favor and don't take her class.

Professor MacAllister seems to be a good person, but not a good teacher. She assigns a lot of reading and expects you to remember the tiniest details for tests. She is not accessible outside of class at all, and was not really open to students asking questions about assignments.

Joyce is a sweet lady but her class is so boring. She doesn't care about her students or remember their names and she loves to talk about horses and cats and it gets super boring. she can grade papers kinda harsh too. I took narratives of personal development which was not great but other classes are supposed to be easier, but NOPD is not an easy A
Off the addy class still boring yaheard me

Class is as boring as it gets. Feedback on graded assignments is not timely. Office hours are not particularly useful. Oftentimes does not remember who is who. Might think this is the only class you take.

Honestly in her class i should have brought a pillow with me. She requires you to be there. If you have the option between taking this and literally any other Fys choose any other. Oh btw she loves her class and will let you know every class. I highly suggest watching a movie 80 times or until its locked in your brain. This may help you pass time.

She is a very nice lady but sometimes confused me about what she wants for papers and test preparations. The books are not very interesting but her tests are HARD! All about details like names and terms from 7 books, which is impossible to remember. Overall great lady with charming personality, but I won't take her again.

Dr. MacAllister's class can be very interesting for animal lovers (definitely take this fys if you love horses). She's very lenient on tests, and you'll get fair grades on papers as long as you put enough effort into them.

Though the first two books for this class are quite hard to read, the latter ones are much better and you may enjoy them even if you are not an animal person. She is a tough grader on papers but a great person who really cares about her students. She would give you lots of feedbacks on your assignments and even tests for you to do better next time.

Her classes are boring and the readings are excessive. Moreover, the readings aren't even interesting. For tests you are expected to remember every minute detail. Do not take her unless you're really into animals and love reading about them (it's no fun).

She taught me Noble Beasts, but is normally a Writing/English professor. Terribly tough grader on papers, but remarkably easier with tests, she understands that you'll make grammatical mistakes on tests. You need to read the chapters assigned, not for quizzes but rather, because it's the only way to write the papers adequately in terms of content.
Do not take her. Doesn't care about the students. The class is reading comprehension with BS tests and essays. It is boring and impossible

Her class is not difficult and rather rewarding if you are willing to put in the work that is required. The kids that struggled with the writing and tests are the ones who never read a single book. The course is rather faced paced but totally doable. Dr. MacAllister is a totally underrated professor. She is smart and helpful.

Super easy and class is a joke. Show up, skim the readings, and get help on your papers and you'll get an A. I went to her for help on my papers and was great, although you have to bring a thesis or she wont help you. If you don't go for help she'll pull a grade out of her ass so be careful. but if youre looking for an easy seminar, this is it

Don't take her for Noble Beasts, she was terrible. She gives absurd essay prompts and does not give any assistance even when the entire class questions the meaning of her prompts. Not worth wasting your time being frustrated with her. She treated us like we were a fourth grade class and had ridiculous requirements for essay writing. Not worth it.

She is really sweet but somewhat challenging.  She assigns a lot of reading homework and expects everyone to stay caught up.  She seems to think that pop quizzes are rewards.  But she is a fair grader and even though she has no idea how to use technology she tries her hardest.  Slightly absent-minded but quite amusing...
Please try your best to avoid her!!! reading responses due every class, hard grader, midterm and final are just a matter of reciting, if you are good at memorizing everything...

Literally the worst professor I've ever had. Impossible to do well on exams and papers, very dry, and very old. She loves cats. The daily reading responses become overbearing, and the discussions she leads are boring to say the least. If your writing doesn't fit the mold that she likes, she will fail you. Don't take her class.

Ohhhh Joyce... gotta love her. She is a good professor, slightly boring though. The fact that she is obsessed with cats and horse races makes her awesome. I did take some good knowledge out of the class though... not sure if I would take it again just because it was really repetitive. Sometimes that was nice, you always know whats expected.

Joyce assigns reading responses due for every class, which is actually really annoying, but without them I wouldn't have read any of the core books. So in a way that is somewhat helpful. So easy to just sit there and do nothing during class, but I thought she was a tough paper-grader.
do not take her, just don't, if you do by mistake transfer out.  If you take her you will waste your time and get a C.
She is just way to AMBIGIOUS!

Her quiet, monotonous voice, interlaced with "mk"s and "alright"s will enchant you straight away. Her arbitrary grades are based on her whims. There is not a single person in this class that would still be here if the class wasn't required. To use a simile, herclass is like dying from excessive acupuncture.

If you actually listen to what she has to say in class (which most people don't do), you will find that she is a good teacher.  She has her favorites, though, so watch out.  Athletes beware also...she doesn't get along with the athletics department.  On a personal level I enjoyed the class and did well.

i thought i would get an easy A, but with three assignments and two of those grades not given back before the end of the semester, i ended up with much lower than I expected. The class has no work, but I have no idea where she pulls the grades from.
Joyce was interesting, she's a little flighty but a very nice woman. Sweet lady, pretty easy, I liked learning about Lindbergh!
One of the worst proffessors I ever had.  She told me that the concept of the "melting pot" didn't exist and gave me a C on my paper.  Brilliant!

Horrible teacher. Not difficult at all, but a complete space cadet. If you're looking for an easy grade, look no further; however, if you're looking to learn something with the $1000 you're spending on the class...look elsewhere. She brought her cat to our midterm exam. Need I say more?

Worst teacher I have ever had.  I asked her once if I could meet with her because I did not understand how she grades and she refused to meet with me, no joke.  Every time I asked her to meet, she would tell me to go to the writing center.  If she dislikes you, you will get a bad grade, guaranteed.
worst teacher ever

im still stuck with a fat '?'.  umm she doesn't really specify what she wants, refuses to look at work before you hand it in, and seems to favor students.  my advice, become one of the students she likes.
She is awesome, very nice and not too hard. Very underrated.
homework never took too long. Just do the homework and you're grade will be fine. Paper topics were never very hard. Classes were boring. Get on her good side.

Impossible to please.  Every time I would improve my work based on what she suggested I do, she would find some other arbitrary problem.  Wound up with a B+ in the class, but that's only because she co-instructed with Dr. Essid.
ask her about her cats....
ridiculous..
almost impossible to get on her good list.  If you're on her bad side you've got a huge problem.  Does not like to talk to students ourside of class.
cant stand that class or her
easy, but just because she doesn't seem to particularly care about her work, nor her students. Very cold and hard to relate to.
I don't feel my writing improved at all during this course.  It was a waste of time.  She doesn;t listen to the concerns of students and has a strange gradign system
Unlike many posters here, I thought she was very fair and made her standards clear.
HORRIBLE
SHE IS THE WORST TEACHER EVER!!

I can't deal with this woman. She does not reward ability at all. Her grading policies are retarded...she actually counts off points on your tests and then applies a totally subjective grade to them that doesn't even match the amount she counted off.
She has no consistancy with grading, she has no interest in the ability of her students to improve, she simply looks for all the bad, and does not reward the good
Interesting class, although the tests are VERY detailed.  Overall I'd recommend her.
i feel sorry for her
She had no grading standards, so it should've been easy, but wasn't
